answer.answer:
### Chain map: market requirement → measurable parameter → Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer capability
| Market / application requirement | Measurable parameter | Required Signal Generator capability | Required Signal Analyzer capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5G FWA CPE RF parametric testing is mostly required by operators, and the source maps this requirement to VSG / VSA instruments including R&S SMW200A and R&S FSW.[68] | Output power, EVM, OBW, receiver sensitivity level BLER, band permutations and CAs.[68] | VSG / R&S SMW200A is listed as an instrument category for these 5G FWA UE test requirements.[68] | VSA / R&S FSW is listed as an instrument category for these 5G FWA UE test requirements.[68] |
| 5G FWA CPE OTA testing is required by operators to verify antenna performance, and FR2 OTA / thermal measurements can include 3D positioner TRP / TIS measurements and thermal bubble / camera.[68][71] | CTIA OTA antenna-performance metrics, including TRP / TIS in the FR2 OTA context.[68][71] | R&S SMW200A is listed among the instruments for the 5G FWA UE test requirement set.[68] | R&S FSW is listed among the instruments for the 5G FWA UE test requirement set.[68] |
| 5G NTN-NR is gaining interest from chipset / device manufacturers, automotive, and satellite / space industry, with initial focus on transparent payload in S/L bands and later extension to regenerative architecture and other bands.[2] | Long path delay, enhanced Doppler, and customized dynamic fading.[2] | R&S SMW200A channel emulation capabilities for NTN testing include long path delays, enhanced Doppler capabilities, and customized dynamic fading.[2] | R&S FSW / FSWX supports satellite payload testing, EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, and phase-coherent multichannel measurement.[30] |
| NTN end-to-end system testing emulates the RF satellite link between UE and NTN payload using service-link and feeder-link channel emulators.[3] | Update interval, delay, Doppler, and pathloss are key parameters for customized dynamic fading and trajectory-based fading files.[3] | R&S SMW200A with firmware version ≥ 5.30, B14 or B15, and R&S SMW-K820 supports customized dynamic fading, satellite trajectory modelling, frequency-dependent atmospheric effects, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler.[3] | The cited E2E system-testing passage specifies channel-emulator / signal-generator capabilities and does not specify a Signal Analyzer requirement for that E2E setup.[3] |
| SAN conformance testing targets a transparent-payload Satellite Access Node DUT and includes gateway, NTN payload RF, gNB, feeder-link emulator, signal generator, service-link channel emulator, and throughput measurement point.[53] | SAN testing focus includes output power, power dynamics, frequency error, modulation quality, ACLR, OBUE, receiver sensitivity, blocking, and PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance.[93] | R&S SMW200A SAN testing key features include FRCs, TMs, fading module, AWGN module, static UE propagation models, TDL and moving propagation, SISO / MIMO, and B14 / B15 + K71 moving propagation.[53] | R&S FSW / FSWX supports EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, and phase-coherent multichannel measurement for satellite payload testing.[30] |
| 5G NTN SAN conformance configurations are stated for testing needs up to 160 MHz or up to 200 MHz with support for TS 38.181 Rel.17 SAN testing requirements.[52] | Signal bandwidth up to 160 MHz or 200 MHz, delay requirements, and residual Doppler requirements for LEO.[52] | SMW B10/B14 supports signal bandwidths up to 160 MHz, delay requirements, and residual Doppler requirements for LEO; SMW B9/B15 is recommended for testing needs up to 200 MHz with support for delay and residual Doppler requirements for LEO.[52] | R&S FSW / FSVA 5G NR options are described as supporting Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 measurements in the NTN source context.[50] |
| NTN component testing uses DUT, R&S SMW200A, and R&S FSW.[57] | Frequency coverage, RF modulation bandwidth, analysis bandwidth, and cellular / OFDM / vector signal generation or analysis software are the measurable capability areas listed for component testing.[57] | R&S SMW200A is summarized for component testing as frequency up to 67 GHz, overrange 72 GHz, RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz, up to 4 GHz with R&S SMW-K555, and signal generation software for LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18 via K171, OFDM via K114, and custom digital modulation.[57] | R&S FSW is summarized for component testing as frequency up to 85 GHz, overrange 90 GHz, analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz, and signal analysis software for LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18 via K171, OFDM via K96, and Vector signal analysis via K70.[57] |
| NTN changes wireless T&M assumptions because both UE and network entities can be mobile and test setups must include high path loss, Doppler shift, time delay, delay variance, atmospheric effects, Faraday effect, scintillation, and weather influences.[92] | High path loss, Doppler shift, time delay, delay variance, atmospheric effects, Faraday effect, scintillation, and weather influences.[92] | R&S SMW200A can be equipped with fading emulator support for TDL / CDL, custom fading profile, Doppler, delay, path loss, and R&S SMW-K820 customized dynamic fading; R&S SpaceNexus can configure satellite constellation, UE position / mobility, time-variant Doppler, time-variant propagation delay, path loss, and weather-induced attenuation and remote configure SMW200A.[30] | R&S FSW / FSWX supports satellite payload testing, EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, and phase-coherent multichannel measurement.[30] |
### Limits
The 5G FWA UE test requirement taxonomy is a solution overview and does not provide test cases, limits, configurations, or pass / fail criteria.[15]  
The NTN signal-generator source is a 2025 presentation / OneNote-derived source and is not a formal datasheet, configuration guide, price book, or 3GPP specification.[55]  
The SMW200A NTN E2E channel-emulation page states that dynamic fading, Doppler, and path-delay numbers need confirmation against formal SMW200A fading specifications and relevant application notes.[35]

3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › 重點摘要
此來源是由 `3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR.pptx` 轉出的 lossy markdown；封面標示 `1GP` 與 `12-2025`，末頁標示 `Last updated: 08/25`，其中 slide 27 另標示 `2025-09-29 Nokia Workshop at R&S - SigGen Product Update`。本頁以來源原文呈現的 2025 年簡報語境處理，不自行推論正式發布日。

簡報主題是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 針對 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] 的 signal generator / channel emulation 測試方案，涵蓋：

- [[5G NTN-NR]] 的 Release 17 / 18 / 19 演進與頻段。
- [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）conformance testing。
- [[NTN signal generator solutions]] 的 component testing、SAN testing、end-to-end system testing 與 UE testing 分層。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 作為 channel emulator / signal generator 的 NTN 測試能力。
- [[R&S FSW]] 與 [[R&S FSVA3000]] 在 component testing / SAN transmitter measurement 中的角色。
- [[R&S Space Nexus]] 依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files 的待請求 PC software 線索。

3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › NTN end-to-end system testing
來源 slide 24–28 說 E2E system testing 會以 channel emulator for service link 與 channel emulator for feeder link 模擬 UE、NTN payload 之間的 RF satellite link。

來源 slide 25 標示 `SMW firmware version ≥ 5.30`，key features 包含：

- Flexible definition of terrestrial channel profiles；B14 or B15 required。
- Customized dynamic fading；K820 required。
- Model satellite trajectory。
- Account for frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- Longer path delays and enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- Up to 1073 ms delay。
- Up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

來源 slide 26 對 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 的 E2E testing key features：customer-provided list、flexible definition of satellite movement、possibility to account for frequency-dependent atmospheric effects、longer path delays and enhanced Doppler capabilities。Key parameters：update interval、delay、Doppler、pathloss。

來源 slide 27 說 [[R&S Space Nexus]] 是 PC Software，available on request，可 generate SMW200A fading files based on a satellite trajectory；key parameters 同為 update interval、delay、Doppler、pathloss。

NTN signal generator solutions › End-to-end system testing
來源將 E2E system testing 描述為對 UE、NTN payload、service link channel emulator 與 feeder link channel emulator 的 RF satellite link emulation。[[R&S SMW200A]] 需要 firmware version ≥ 5.30，並透過 B14 或 B15 搭配 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 支援：

- satellite trajectory modelling。
- frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- longer path delays。
- enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- up to 1073 ms delay。
- up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

[[R&S Space Nexus]] 在來源中被描述為 PC Software，available on request，可依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files。

詳見 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

NTN signal generator solutions › 與 NTN validation / conformance 的關係
- [[5G NTN validation and testing]]：較寬的 NTN validation、partner collaboration、CMX500 / SMBV100B / Viasat / Gatehouse / MediaTek PR 語境。
- [[NR-NTN conformance testing]]：偏 UE / GCF / PTCRB / TS8980 / CMX500 conformance validation。
- [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]]：本來源新增的 Satellite Access Node 測試概念，聚焦 SAN transmitter、receiver、performance 與 OTA chapters。
- [[NTN propagation emulation and fading]]：既有 CMX500 PR 中 propagation emulation 與 fading 的概念；本來源補充 SMW200A dynamic fading / Doppler / path delay 實作線索。

NTN signal generator solutions › 來源中的 solution 分層
[[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] 將 NTN testing 分為四類：

- Component Testing。
- [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）Testing。
- End-to-end System Testing。
- User Equipment（UE）Testing。

來源可讀內容主要展開前三者，尤其是 [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 channel emulation、[[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 與 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › Digital I/Q
- Standard digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K18`；wideband digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K19`。
- Digital I/Q input/output 可用於 [[R&S SMW200A]] 與其他 Rohde & Schwarz 儀器之間的 lossless connection，例如 [[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMM100A]]、[[R&S SMCV100B]] 或 CMW500 wideband radio communication tester 的 fading applications。
- DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface PAD-R`，level `LVDS`，connector `26-pin MDR`。
- HS DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R`，connector `QSFP+/QSFP 28`。
- Wideband HS DIG I/Q standard system configuration mode：40G up to `1.05 GHz`，50G up to `1.25 GHz`；advanced mode with `R&S®SMW-K822` input up to `500 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K823` input up to `1000 MHz`。

R&S SMW200A › Unresolved
- 來源未標示價格。
- 本頁整合 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（configuration guide，May 2024）與 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（specifications，May 2026）；兩者文件性質不同。報價前應回查正式 PDF、最新 ordering information 與 configure 工具。
- Multichannel、MIMO、fading、digital standards、GNSS/avionics、external pulse sequencer options 的完整規格需另查引用文件：`PD 3673.1276.22`、`PD 5213.9434.22`、`PD 3607.6896.22`、`PD 3607.1388.22`。
- RF path combination table 的全部 allowed / not allowed combinations 與灰底 deeper chassis 條件需回查原表；本頁只照錄來源明列摘要與 `R&S®SMW-B94L` 明列條件。
- Recommended rack adapter 與 2 m digital baseband cable 在 May 2024 configuration guide 與 May 2026 specifications 不一致；不可自行判定是否替代或等效。
- 來源為分段萃取重點，不是完整逐頁文字；圖表曲線僅記錄來源明列的文字與數字。
- 來源提供讀圖補充為 p001 封面資訊，但本次提示未提供可原封不動複製的圖片嵌入行；依 productions 讀圖規則，未把讀圖內容作為規格主張寫入本頁。

R&S CMW500 › NGeCall over LTE capability
[[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]]（Oct. 2024）指出，[[R&S CMW500]] 可作為 standalone setup，搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] 或 [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 進行 [[NGeCall over LTE]] 測試能力對照。

R&S CMW500 › 重要限制
- 來源明示：[[R&S CMW500]] 有時只支援部分測試，某些測試需要進一步設備。
- 多個 CEN/TS 17240 IVS 測試需要外部 HMI interaction、ignition switched OFF 控制、manufacturer specific AT command、IVS debugging tool、prepared TestUSIM 或 handset；這些不完全由 KA09x software 控制。
- CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available；需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS call-back abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 標示 Not available。
- 來源註明 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 [[NGeCall over LTE]] / IMS 的 transition 尚未由 EU commission 最終決定，因此部分涉及 handover 的 test cases 尚未實作。

R&S CMW500 › 規格條件
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。
- 需至少 15 minutes warm-up time，環境溫度與指定 environmental conditions 符合要求，calibration cycle 已遵守，且所有 internal automatic adjustments 已執行。
- `typ.` 為 typical values，在 final test 中驗證，但 Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Nominal values 為 design parameters，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Calibration interval：12 months recommended for highest accuracy；24 months 時需在 specified RF generator 與 RF analyzer level uncertainty 加上 0.2 dB。

5G device testing value chain › 使用限制
- 本頁不是 3GPP conformance specification，也不是 R&S formal product configuration guide。
- 來源中的工具 mapping 是 solution overview / sales enablement 層級；不得替代 datasheet、test case list、option dependency 或 calibration procedure。

5G device testing value chain › Shuffler 與 CMsequencer
來源描述 [[Shuffler]] 可在 one go 執行 device 支援 UE band combos 的 RF / throughput test，並以 one test script with one test report 取得 RF TX/RX measurement、RX sensitivity、Throughput、VoLTE / VoNR 等 summarized results。來源說：

- Shuffler tests part of [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] test package。
- Shuffler implemented in [[R&S CMsequencer]]。
- Band combinations 可由 UE capabilities 或 user-defined Excel sheet 輸入。
- Band combo support table 包含 LTE 4/5 LTE CA、LTE + NR 4 LTE + 2 NR / 5 LTE + 2 NR、NR 2–4 NR CA、NRDC、LTE + FR1、LTE + FR2。

此處為 solution overview；[[R&S CMX-KF612M]] 的正式 feature list、order number、CSW version 與 supported bands 仍需正式 R&S 文件補證。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

5G device testing value chain
[[5G device testing value chain]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中整理的 5G device ecosystem 測試分工：從 chip vendor、device manufacturer、test house 到 network operator，依 Lab、R&D、Production、Operations 與 Use cases 串接 RF、signaling、application、OTA、pre-conformance、conformance、carrier acceptance 與 service / repair 測試。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › fading and path loss
來源指出 satellite connectivity 除 terrestrial fading profiles 外還需要 new fading profiles，包括 atmospheric fading 與 terrestrial fading 的組合，以及 rain、cloud、sun storms causing electron flow 等 weather-specific effects emulation。Large distance 造成 high free space path loss，導致 UE side low SNR。來源列出：

- Minimum SINR ≥ -10 dB。
- Minimum RSRP ≥ -137 dBm。
- NTN 第一階段目標為 outdoor connections。

來源未提供 3GPP clause、test condition 或 scenario profile，因此只作為測試需求線索。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

NTN IoT device testing requirements › long delay
來源指出 UE 到 satellite 的距離造成 long absolute delay：

- [[LEO]] 約 40 ms。
- [[GEO]] 約 544 ms。

Satellite orbital movement 在 connection time 期間造成 time variant delay；RTT 會因 elevation angle 與 LEO 場景而變動。RTT 相關參數包含 [[SIB31]]、K_mac、K_offset、[[SIB32]]。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

NTN IoT device testing requirements › CMW500 Rel.17 NB-NTN test solution 線索
來源指出 May 2023：[[R&S CMW500]] Signaling Tester Extension to Rel.17 NTN。來源列出 [[R&S CMW500]] 支援：

- MLAPI。
- all protocol stack extensions and IEs。
- GEO / GSO / LEO / MEO emulation。
- Testcase scenarios：single / multi cell、SIB31 and SIB32 support、fixed delay up to 540 ms、variable delay、Doppler +/- 50 kHz（LEO）、RF measurements view、Registration / IP / NIP / PSM / cDRX / E2E。

NB-NTN Rel.17 Test Solution products 包含：

- CMW500 Mobile Radio Tester Hardware。
- [[R&S CMW-KP030]] NB-IoT FRAMEWORK。
- [[R&S CMW-KR317]] REL.17 NB-IOT STACK EXTENSION。
- [[R&S CMW-KU317]] REL.17 NB-NTN SAMPLE SCENARIOS。
- [[R&S CMW-KK307]] REL.17 3GPP PCT Testcases。
- GNSS 需要 additional [[R&S SMBV100B]]。

來源也描述 lab-based all-in-one NB-NTN simulation 包含 CMW500、SMBV100B、GNSS Signal Generator、NB-NTN R&D Testcase、Satellite Control Module、Doppler / Delay module driver、Doppler / Delay module、Stack / PHY layer、TRX、RF frontend、Signaling FPGA。Simulation inputs / parameters 包含 constellation、DUT location、UTC time、SIB31、SIB32 params、Doppler、dynamic delay projection、NTN config、time alignment、delay config、IQ data。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

NTN test and measurement aspects › 使用限制
- 本頁是 T&M 技術總覽；正式 test methods、limits、tolerances、test case IDs 與 validation status 需查 [[TS 38.101-5]]、[[TS 38.521-5]]、[[TS 38.523]]、[[TS 38.533]]、[[TS 38.181]]、[[TS 38.108]]、GCF / PTCRB public documents。
- R&S 產品能力需以正式 datasheet / configuration guide 為準；白皮書中的 solution-level 描述不可直接作為 quote / BOM / orderable capability。
- OTA / PAAM setup 的 fixtures、antenna modules、chamber dimensions、quiet zone、polarization、frequency conversions 等需以原圖與 setup note 回查。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Signal generation、analysis 與 SpaceNexus
來源描述：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可配備 fading emulator，支援 TDL / CDL、custom fading profile、Doppler、delay、path loss，以及 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading。
- [[R&S SpaceNexus]] 可設定 satellite constellation、UE position / mobility、time-variant Doppler、time-variant propagation delay、path loss、weather-induced attenuation，並 remote configure SMW200A。
- [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSWX]] 支援 satellite payload testing、EVM、ACLR、group delay、DVB-S2X analysis、phase-coherent multichannel measurement。
- [[R&S PVT360A]] 被描述為 potential satellite production testing platform，整合 vector signal generator 與 vector spectrum analyzer。

NTN propagation emulation and fading
[[NTN propagation emulation and fading]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz highlights its unique CMX500 one-box tester tailored for NTN testing at MWC Barcelona 2026]] 中用來區分 satellite space-to-ground effects 與 terrestrial impairments 的測試概念；來源宣稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 可將兩者分開建模與控制，以支援更 accurate and flexible 的 NTN scenario testing。

NTN propagation emulation and fading › 使用限制
- 來源是 PR，不是 channel model specification、measurement application note 或 formal datasheet。
- 來源未提供 propagation emulation 與 fading 的正式模型名稱、3GPP clause、parameter range、implementation architecture、supported bands、supported orbit profiles 或 calibration method。
- 來源宣稱 only available NTN test solution，但未提供競品清單、比較日期或 benchmark 方法。
- 不可由本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 的正式 fading option、channel emulator 規格、measurement uncertainty 或 conformance coverage。

NTN propagation emulation and fading › 來源中的區分
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz highlights its unique CMX500 one-box tester tailored for NTN testing at MWC Barcelona 2026]]，[[R&S CMX500]] is the only available [[NTN]] test solution that differentiates between propagation emulation and fading。

來源將 effects 區分為：

| 類別 | 來源描述 |
|---|---|
| space-to-ground effects | Doppler、delay、scattering |
| terrestrial impairments | reflections、receiver-induced Doppler |

來源主張這種區分讓 space-to-ground effects and terrestrial impairments 可以 independently modeled and controlled。

SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation
[[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]]（封面標示 12-2025）中描述的 end-to-end NTN system testing 方法：用 [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 fading / channel emulation 功能模擬 service link 與 feeder link 的 RF satellite link，並透過 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 或 [[R&S Space Nexus]] 產生 trajectory-based fading files。

SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation › 使用限制
- 來源為 2025 簡報，不是 [[R&S SMW200A]] specifications 或 fading option datasheet。
- dynamic fading / Doppler / path delay 數字需回查正式 SMW200A fading specifications 與 relevant application note。
- slide 28 多個欄位空白或無法可靠辨識；本頁不補推 missing values。

- 此頁不等同 [[NTN propagation emulation and fading]] 中 CMX500 PR 對 propagation emulation / fading 的術語區分。

SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation › E2E system testing 架構
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 24，E2E system testing 圖中包含：

- UE。
- Channel emulator for service link。
- NTN payload。
- Channel emulator for feeder link。
- 圖上另標示兩組 2 paths。

來源將此歸為 [[NTN signal generator solutions]] 的 End-to-end System Testing 類別。

- 來源明示 supported technologies：[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]]、[[Direct-to-Cell]]（D2C / DTC）。

- 支援更準確的 satellite radio channel modelling。

- 支援 faster validation cycles、earlier identification of system-level issues 與 stronger test conditions。

R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。

R&S SMW200A › 主要 RF performance（Version 31.00，May 2026）
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

- Frequency range：依 RF path frequency option，RF path A 最高 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`；RF path B 最高 `100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- Overrange：`67 GHz to 72 GHz`。
- Resolution of setting：`0.001 Hz`。
- Resolution of synthesis：`0.053 nHz nominal`，條件 `f = 1 GHz`。
- Frequency setting time：依 frequency option 為 `< 1.2 ms` 至 `< 1.8 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` 為 `< 4.0 ms`。條件包含 GUI update stopped、I/Q optimization mode fast、after IEC/IEEE bus delimiter、HUMS off。
- Frequency setting time in list mode：依 frequency option為 `< 0.8 ms` 至 `< 1.4 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721`、run mode live 為 `< 4.0 ms`。
- Level setting range：`100 kHz ≤ f < 1 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +8 dBm`；`1 MHz ≤ f < 3 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +13 dBm`；`3 MHz ≤ f ≤ 67 GHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +30 dBm`。
- Standard performance SSB phase noise 條件：CW，carrier offset `20 kHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 Hz`，level `10 dBm` 或 maximum specified output power 兩者較低者；`f = 1 GHz` 為 `< –134 dBc`，typ. `–140 dBc`。
- `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` ultra low phase noise 在 `1 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–144 dBc`，typ. `–150 dBc`；在 `67 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–105 dBc`，typ. `–111 dBc`。
- Pulse modulation 需 `R&S®SMW-K22`；一般 on/off ratio `> 80 dB`，部分高頻條件例外為 `> 65 dB`。
- Pulse rise/fall time（10 % / 90 % of RF amplitude）：低頻 frequency options fast transition `< 10 ns`；多數 20 GHz 以上 options fast transition `< 15 ns`；smoothed transition 多數條件 `< 200 ns`。
- Internal baseband I/Q、wideband baseband (`R&S®SMW-B13XT`)、I/Q wideband on：`f > 2.5 GHz` 時 `±1 GHz`；RF modulation bandwidth 可達 `2 GHz`。

5G device testing value chain › Validation and Conformance 目標

- Chipset L1–L4 test plan and verification。

- 本頁不是 3GPP NTN standard、NB-NTN certification plan 或 R&S formal order configuration。

- Market forecast 與 project examples 需回 GSMA Intelligence、operator / satellite company PR 或 regulatory filings 驗證。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › UE procedures
來源描述 NTN IoT UE procedures：

- UE determines its terrestrial position，例如 via [[GNSS]]。
- Satellite 透過 SIB broadcast 通知 orbit information、velocity、common parameters。
- UE 根據 estimated UE position 與 satellite position 計算 propagation delay。
- UE derives initial timing advance and frequency shift for first radio access。
- 依 SIB setting，UE 在 RACH procedure 期間 reports timing advance。
- 相關標準語境為 3GPP R17 / 3GPP Rel. 17 NTN-IoT。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › connection、segmentation 與 mobility
來源描述 NTN IoT long / short connections 流程：

- Deep sleep。
- GNSS acquisition。
- SIB acquisition。
- PRACH。

UE 使用 GNSS position 與 SIB info 來 precompensate timing advance 與 UL frequency。UL segmented transmission is possible，但 drawback 是 re-acquisition of GNSS + SIB and precompensation 增加 energy consumption。UE capability / network config 包含 minimum supported gap length between segments；`ntn-SegmentedPrecompensationGaps` 可為 1 symbol、1 slot、1 subframe。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

來源列出的 NTN mobility scenarios 包含：

- Cell selection / cell reselection。
- Intra-satellite / inter-beam handover。
- Inter-satellite handover / inter-satellite dual connectivity。
- NTN – terrestrial handover / dual connectivity。
- NR-NTN connection。
- Target or simultaneous dual connectivity NR-NTN connection。
- Target or simultaneous dual connectivity terrestrial connection。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Mobile network testing（MNT）
來源指出 [[Mobile network testing]] 可擴展至 NTN：

- passive testing：scanner 監測 downlink spectrum，不建立連線。
- active testing：test UE / QualiPoc Android 做 connected mode / E2E QoS / QoE testing。
- NTN MNT metrics 包含 RSRP、RSRQ、RS-SINR、RSSI、spectrum clearance、RTT、packet loss、BLER、throughput、mobility、random access success、SIB decoding、SMS / voice / video QoE。
- DTC LEO 與 Skylo IoT-NTN drive test examples 被作為 MNT early scenarios。

NTN test and measurement aspects › OTA / phased array / PAAM testing
NTN UE、VSAT、SAN、satellite 可能使用 directive antennas / phased array antennas，因此 OTA testing 重要。

| NTN end-to-end system testing emulates the RF satellite link between UE and NTN payload using service-link and feeder-link channel emulators.[3] | Update interval, delay, Doppler, and pathloss are key parameters for customized dynamic fading and trajectory-based fading files.[3] | R&S SMW200A with firmware version ≥ 5.30, B14 or B15, and R&S SMW-K820 supports customized dynamic fading, satellite trajectory modelling, frequency-dependent atmospheric effects, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler.[3] | The cited E2E system-testing passage specifies channel-emulator / signal-generator capabilities and does not specify a Signal Analyzer requirement for that E2E setup.[3] |
| SAN conformance testing targets a transparent-payload Satellite Access Node DUT and includes gateway, NTN payload RF, gNB, feeder-link emulator, signal generator, service-link channel emulator, and throughput measurement point.[53] | SAN testing focus includes output power, power dynamics, frequency error, modulation quality, ACLR, OBUE, receiver sensitivity, blocking, and PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance.[93] | R&S SMW200A SAN testing key features include FRCs, TMs, fading module, AWGN module, static UE propagation models, TDL and moving propagation, SISO / MIMO, and B14 / B15 + K71 moving propagation.[53] | R&S FSW / FSWX supports EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, and phase-coherent multichannel measurement for satellite payload testing.[30] |
| 5G NTN SAN conformance configurations are stated for testing needs up to 160 MHz or up to 200 MHz with support for TS 38.181 Rel.17 SAN testing requirements.[52] | Signal bandwidth up to 160 MHz or 200 MHz, delay requirements, and residual Doppler requirements for LEO.[52] | SMW B10/B14 supports signal bandwidths up to 160 MHz, delay requirements, and residual Doppler requirements for LEO; SMW B9/B15 is recommended for testing needs up to 200 MHz with support for delay and residual Doppler requirements for LEO.[52] | R&S FSW / FSVA 5G NR options are described as supporting Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 measurements in the NTN source context.[50] |

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。

- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。

- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

來源將 E2E system testing 描述為對 UE、NTN payload、service link channel emulator 與 feeder link channel emulator 的 RF satellite link emulation。[[R&S SMW200A]] 需要 firmware version ≥ 5.30，並透過 B14 或 B15 搭配 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 支援：

- satellite trajectory modelling。
- frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- longer path delays。
- enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- up to 1073 ms delay。
- up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

[[R&S Space Nexus]] 在來源中被描述為 PC Software，available on request，可依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files。

詳見 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

NTN signal generator solutions › 與 NTN validation / conformance 的關係
- [[5G NTN validation and testing]]：較寬的 NTN validation、partner collaboration、CMX500 / SMBV100B / Viasat / Gatehouse / MediaTek PR 語境。
- [[NR-NTN conformance testing]]：偏 UE / GCF / PTCRB / TS8980 / CMX500 conformance validation。
- [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]]：本來源新增的 Satellite Access Node 測試概念，聚焦 SAN transmitter、receiver、performance 與 OTA chapters。
- [[NTN propagation emulation and fading]]：既有 CMX500 PR 中 propagation emulation 與 fading 的概念；本來源補充 SMW200A dynamic fading / Doppler / path delay 實作線索。

NTN signal generator solutions › 來源中的 solution 分層
[[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] 將 NTN testing 分為四類：

- Component Testing。
- [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）Testing。
- End-to-end System Testing。
- User Equipment（UE）Testing。

來源可讀內容主要展開前三者，尤其是 [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 channel emulation、[[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 與 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › Digital I/Q
- Standard digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K18`；wideband digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K19`。
- Digital I/Q input/output 可用於 [[R&S SMW200A]] 與其他 Rohde & Schwarz 儀器之間的 lossless connection，例如 [[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMM100A]]、[[R&S SMCV100B]] 或 CMW500 wideband radio communication tester 的 fading applications。
- DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface PAD-R`，level `LVDS`，connector `26-pin MDR`。
- HS DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R`，connector `QSFP+/QSFP 28`。
- Wideband HS DIG I/Q standard system configuration mode：40G up to `1.05 GHz`，50G up to `1.25 GHz`；advanced mode with `R&S®SMW-K822` input up to `500 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K823` input up to `1000 MHz`。

- 來源明示：[[R&S CMW500]] 有時只支援部分測試，某些測試需要進一步設備。

- CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS call-back abnormal termination 標示 Not available。

- Calibration interval：12 months recommended for highest accuracy；24 months 時需在 specified RF generator 與 RF analyzer level uncertainty 加上 0.2 dB。

5G device testing value chain › Shuffler 與 CMsequencer
來源描述 [[Shuffler]] 可在 one go 執行 device 支援 UE band combos 的 RF / throughput test，並以 one test script with one test report 取得 RF TX/RX measurement、RX sensitivity、Throughput、VoLTE / VoNR 等 summarized results。來源說：

- Shuffler tests part of [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] test package。
- Shuffler implemented in [[R&S CMsequencer]]。
- Band combinations 可由 UE capabilities 或 user-defined Excel sheet 輸入。
- Band combo support table 包含 LTE 4/5 LTE CA、LTE + NR 4 LTE + 2 NR / 5 LTE + 2 NR、NR 2–4 NR CA、NRDC、LTE + FR1、LTE + FR2。

此處為 solution overview；[[R&S CMX-KF612M]] 的正式 feature list、order number、CSW version 與 supported bands 仍需正式 R&S 文件補證。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

5G device testing value chain
[[5G device testing value chain]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中整理的 5G device ecosystem 測試分工：從 chip vendor、device manufacturer、test house 到 network operator，依 Lab、R&D、Production、Operations 與 Use cases 串接 RF、signaling、application、OTA、pre-conformance、conformance、carrier acceptance 與 service / repair 測試。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › fading and path loss
來源指出 satellite connectivity 除 terrestrial fading profiles 外還需要 new fading profiles，包括 atmospheric fading 與 terrestrial fading 的組合，以及 rain、cloud、sun storms causing electron flow 等 weather-specific effects emulation。Large distance 造成 high free space path loss，導致 UE side low SNR。來源列出：

- Minimum SINR ≥ -10 dB。
- Minimum RSRP ≥ -137 dBm。
- NTN 第一階段目標為 outdoor connections。

來源未提供 3GPP clause、test condition 或 scenario profile，因此只作為測試需求線索。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

NTN IoT device testing requirements › long delay
來源指出 UE 到 satellite 的距離造成 long absolute delay：

- [[LEO]] 約 40 ms。
- [[GEO]] 約 544 ms。

Satellite orbital movement 在 connection time 期間造成 time variant delay；RTT 會因 elevation angle 與 LEO 場景而變動。RTT 相關參數包含 [[SIB31]]、K_mac、K_offset、[[SIB32]]。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

NTN IoT device testing requirements › CMW500 Rel.17 NB-NTN test solution 線索
來源指出 May 2023：[[R&S CMW500]] Signaling Tester Extension to Rel.17 NTN。來源列出 [[R&S CMW500]] 支援：

- MLAPI。
- all protocol stack extensions and IEs。
- GEO / GSO / LEO / MEO emulation。
- Testcase scenarios：single / multi cell、SIB31 and SIB32 support、fixed delay up to 540 ms、variable delay、Doppler +/- 50 kHz（LEO）、RF measurements view、Registration / IP / NIP / PSM / cDRX / E2E。

NB-NTN Rel.17 Test Solution products 包含：

- CMW500 Mobile Radio Tester Hardware。
- [[R&S CMW-KP030]] NB-IoT FRAMEWORK。
- [[R&S CMW-KR317]] REL.17 NB-IOT STACK EXTENSION。
- [[R&S CMW-KU317]] REL.17 NB-NTN SAMPLE SCENARIOS。
- [[R&S CMW-KK307]] REL.17 3GPP PCT Testcases。
- GNSS 需要 additional [[R&S SMBV100B]]。

來源也描述 lab-based all-in-one NB-NTN simulation 包含 CMW500、SMBV100B、GNSS Signal Generator、NB-NTN R&D Testcase、Satellite Control Module、Doppler / Delay module driver、Doppler / Delay module、Stack / PHY layer、TRX、RF frontend、Signaling FPGA。Simulation inputs / parameters 包含 constellation、DUT location、UTC time、SIB31、SIB32 params、Doppler、dynamic delay projection、NTN config、time alignment、delay config、IQ data。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

NTN test and measurement aspects › 使用限制
- 本頁是 T&M 技術總覽；正式 test methods、limits、tolerances、test case IDs 與 validation status 需查 [[TS 38.101-5]]、[[TS 38.521-5]]、[[TS 38.523]]、[[TS 38.533]]、[[TS 38.181]]、[[TS 38.108]]、GCF / PTCRB public documents。
- R&S 產品能力需以正式 datasheet / configuration guide 為準；白皮書中的 solution-level 描述不可直接作為 quote / BOM / orderable capability。
- OTA / PAAM setup 的 fixtures、antenna modules、chamber dimensions、quiet zone、polarization、frequency conversions 等需以原圖與 setup note 回查。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Signal generation、analysis 與 SpaceNexus
來源描述：

R&S SMW200A › 主要 RF performance（Version 31.00，May 2026）

5G FWA CPE deployment and testing requirements › Indoor CPE 與 Outdoor CPE tradeoff
來源指出：

- [[Outdoor CPE]] improves spectrum efficiency，與 [[Indoor CPE]] 相比可服務 2–3 倍更多 households。
- [[Indoor CPE]] 可能需要 2–3 倍更多 spectrum。

- CPE placement 是 operator overall FWA strategy 的重要面向。
- Indoor vs Outdoor CPE 會影響 product adoption 與 operator economics。

5G device testing value chain › 來源日期與範圍
- 主要來源：[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]。
- 來源正式日期：來源未標示。
- 來源內容日期線索：Q2CY2023 ecosystem snapshot、2022 shipment base、2023–2028 LTE / 5G connection forecast、2030 cellular IoT forecast、2035 NTN revenue forecast。
- 本頁整理的是 Market / solution overview，不是正式 test plan、產品規格或標準。

5G device testing value chain › 測試類型
來源列出的測試類型包含：

- [[RF]]。
- [[Signaling]]。
- [[Application testing]]。
- [[OTA testing]]。
- [[Pre-conformance testing]]。
- [[Conformance approval]]。
- [[Carrier acceptance]]。
- [[Non-signaling RF]]。
- [[Signaling Protocol]]。
- [[Service and repair]]。

5G device testing value chain › ecosystem roles
來源列出的 5G device value chain 角色包含：

- [[Network operator]]。
- [[Device manufacturer]]。
- [[Test house]]。
- [[Chip vendor]]。

這些角色橫跨 Lab、R&D、Production、Operations 與 Use cases，不同階段需要不同層級的 test and measurement instruments。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

5G device testing value chain › Validation and Conformance 目標
來源指出 validation and conformance 測試目標包含：

- Chipset L1–L4 test plan and verification。
- Investigate and debug modem stack。
- Validate and optimize end to end performance of IMS / SIP / TCP/IP。
- Investigate and debug app stack。
- Plan、develop、execute 3GPP / carrier device tests。
- Radiated and conducted testing。

測試目的包含：

- Final product according to [[3GPP]] specs and KPIs 的 conformance。
- Final product for different carriers 的 conformance。
- New product introduction test framework 與 pilot production tests。
- 確認 HW / SW 如設計般運作。
- Cellular transceiver systems optimization。
- Meet 3GPP specifications or custom design criteria。
- Assure robustness / reliability and performance on L1–L3。
- Optimize each stack for highest throughput and defined KPIs。
- Ensure robustness / reliability and performance on IMS、TCP/IP stack and app protocols。

5G device testing value chain › Carrier aggregation complexity
來源指出 carrier aggregation combinations 依 [[3GPP]] 約有 ~90K test combinations and test plans。來源列出的 examples 包含：

- NSA ENDC combinations for FR1：90 combinations。
- NSA ENDC combinations for FR2：97 combinations。
- NSA ENDC combinations FR1 & FR2：26 combinations。
- SA NR CA combinations FR1 2CC / 3CC / 4CC：172 combinations。
- SA NR CA combinations FR1 5CC & 6CC：150 combinations。
- SA NR CA combinations FR1 + FR2：193 combinations。
- SA NR DC combinations FR1 + FR2：27 combinations。

來源未提供 3GPP document、release、band-combination table ID 或完整 test plan reference，因此不可將上述數字當成正式標準索引。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

NTN IoT device testing requirements › unresolved
- [[R&S CMW-KP030]]、[[R&S CMW-KR317]]、[[R&S CMW-KU317]]、[[R&S CMW-KK307]] 的正式 availability 與 order number 未確認。
- TTCN expected CW24 / CW25 與 CMW-KK307 launch earliest Q3 or Q4 的年份脈絡需回原投影片。
- NB-NTN customer demo 中 Bullit Cat S75 spelling / model 是否為 [[Bullitt Cat S75]] 需確認。
- NTN topology 圖未提供 transparent / regenerative payload 的具體測試配置。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › 與既有知識的關係
- [[5G NTN validation and testing]] 目前主要整理 R&S / Gatehouse、MediaTek、Viasat 等 PR 層級 validation / demo / certification plan；本頁補入 NTN NB-IoT device-level technical requirements 與 CMW500 Rel.17 NB-NTN solution-overview 線索。
- [[NTN propagation emulation and fading]] 已整理 PR 中 space-to-ground effects vs terrestrial impairments 的區分；本頁補入 delay、Doppler、fading、weather effects、low SNR、SIB31 / SIB32 與 UE precompensation。
- [[R&S CMW500]] 的正式規格仍需回 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]；本頁的 CMW500 NTN 延伸內容來自 Market presentation，不能視為正式 datasheet。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › 使用限制
- 本頁不是 3GPP NTN standard、NB-NTN certification plan 或 R&S formal order configuration。
- CMW500 NTN product codes 的 formal order numbers、software versions、release status 與目前可供性未由本來源完整證明。
- Delay、Doppler、SINR、RSRP、fixed delay up to 540 ms、Doppler +/- 50 kHz 等數字需回標準或正式 app note 驗證。
- Market forecast 與 project examples 需回 GSMA Intelligence、operator / satellite company PR 或 regulatory filings 驗證。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › UE procedures
來源描述 NTN IoT UE procedures：

- UE determines its terrestrial position，例如 via [[GNSS]]。
- Satellite 透過 SIB broadcast 通知 orbit information、velocity、common parameters。
- UE 根據 estimated UE position 與 satellite position 計算 propagation delay。
- UE derives initial timing advance and frequency shift for first radio access。
- 依 SIB setting，UE 在 RACH procedure 期間 reports timing advance。
- 相關標準語境為 3GPP R17 / 3GPP Rel. 17 NTN-IoT。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › connection、segmentation 與 mobility
來源描述 NTN IoT long / short connections 流程：

- Deep sleep。
- GNSS acquisition。
- SIB acquisition。
- PRACH。

UE 使用 GNSS position 與 SIB info 來 precompensate timing advance 與 UL frequency。UL segmented transmission is possible，但 drawback 是 re-acquisition of GNSS + SIB and precompensation 增加 energy consumption。UE capability / network config 包含 minimum supported gap length between segments；`ntn-SegmentedPrecompensationGaps` 可為 1 symbol、1 slot、1 subframe。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

來源列出的 NTN mobility scenarios 包含：

- Cell selection / cell reselection。
- Intra-satellite / inter-beam handover。
- Inter-satellite handover / inter-satellite dual connectivity。
- NTN – terrestrial handover / dual connectivity。
- NR-NTN connection。
- Target or simultaneous dual connectivity NR-NTN connection。
- Target or simultaneous dual connectivity terrestrial connection。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Mobile network testing（MNT）
來源指出 [[Mobile network testing]] 可擴展至 NTN：

- passive testing：scanner 監測 downlink spectrum，不建立連線。
- active testing：test UE / QualiPoc Android 做 connected mode / E2E QoS / QoE testing。
- NTN MNT metrics 包含 RSRP、RSRQ、RS-SINR、RSSI、spectrum clearance、RTT、packet loss、BLER、throughput、mobility、random access success、SIB decoding、SMS / voice / video QoE。
- DTC LEO 與 Skylo IoT-NTN drive test examples 被作為 MNT early scenarios。

NTN test and measurement aspects › OTA / phased array / PAAM testing
NTN UE、VSAT、SAN、satellite 可能使用 directive antennas / phased array antennas，因此 OTA testing 重要。

來源整理：

- OTA methods：far field、near field、CATR、plane wave conversion、anechoic chamber、reverberation chamber。
- PAAM metrics：radiation pattern、scan loss、pointing error、HPBW、sidelobe levels、EIRP、G/T、noise density、EVM、beam switching。
- NTN beam metrics：beam center、beam peak、beam pair、beam pointing accuracy、beam stability、beam squint、OSDD、beam shape capability。
- Rohde & Schwarz setups 使用 [[R&S ZNA]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWX]]、[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S ATS800B]]、[[R&S ATS800R]]、[[R&S ATS1800M]] 等。

NTN test and measurement aspects › UE NTN testing
UE NTN testing categories：

- RF testing。
- protocol testing。
- performance testing。
- carrier acceptance testing。
- interoperability testing。

相關規格：

- [[TS 38.101-5]]：satellite NR UE RF and performance requirements。
- [[TS 38.521-5]]：NR UE satellite access RF / performance conformance procedures。
- [[TS 38.523]]：protocol conformance。
- [[TS 38.533]]：RRM conformance。
- [[TS 38.133]]：RRM requirements。

目前 RF tests 多聚焦 FR1；來源預期未來會擴展到 FR2、Ka-band、Ku-band 與 moving satellite conditions。

| 5G FWA CPE RF parametric testing is mostly required by operators, and the source maps this requirement to VSG / VSA instruments including R&S SMW200A and R&S FSW.[68] | Output power, EVM, OBW, receiver sensitivity level BLER, band permutations and CAs.[68] | VSG / R&S SMW200A is listed as an instrument category for these 5G FWA UE test requirements.[68] | VSA / R&S FSW is listed as an instrument category for these 5G FWA UE test requirements.[68] |
| 5G FWA CPE OTA testing is required by operators to verify antenna performance, and FR2 OTA / thermal measurements can include 3D positioner TRP / TIS measurements and thermal bubble / camera.[68][71] | CTIA OTA antenna-performance metrics, including TRP / TIS in the FR2 OTA context.[68][71] | R&S SMW200A is listed among the instruments for the 5G FWA UE test requirement set.[68] | R&S FSW is listed among the instruments for the 5G FWA UE test requirement set.[68] |
| 5G NTN-NR is gaining interest from chipset / device manufacturers, automotive, and satellite / space industry, with initial focus on transparent payload in S/L bands and later extension to regenerative architecture and other bands.[2] | Long path delay, enhanced Doppler, and customized dynamic fading.[2] | R&S SMW200A channel emulation capabilities for NTN testing include long path delays, enhanced Doppler capabilities, and customized dynamic fading.[2] | R&S FSW / FSWX supports satellite payload testing, EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, and phase-coherent multichannel measurement.[30] |
| NTN end-to-end system testing emulates the RF satellite link between UE and NTN payload using service-link and feeder-link channel emulators.[3] | Update interval, delay, Doppler, and pathloss are key parameters for customized dynamic fading and trajectory-based fading files.[3] | R&S SMW200A with firmware version ≥ 5.30, B14 or B15, and R&S SMW-K820 supports customized dynamic fading, satellite trajectory modelling, frequency-dependent atmospheric effects, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler.[3] | The cited E2E system-testing passage specifies channel-emulator / signal-generator capabilities and does not specify a Signal Analyzer requirement for that E2E setup.[3] |
| SAN conformance testing targets a transparent-payload Satellite Access Node DUT and includes gateway, NTN payload RF, gNB, feeder-link emulator, signal generator, service-link channel emulator, and throughput measurement point.[53] | SAN testing focus includes output power, power dynamics, frequency error, modulation quality, ACLR, OBUE, receiver sensitivity, blocking, and PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance.[93] | R&S SMW200A SAN testing key features include FRCs, TMs, fading module, AWGN module, static UE propagation models, TDL and moving propagation, SISO / MIMO, and B14 / B15 + K71 moving propagation.[53] | R&S FSW / FSWX supports EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, and phase-coherent multichannel measurement for satellite payload testing.[30] |
| 5G NTN SAN conformance configurations are stated for testing needs up to 160 MHz or up to 200 MHz with support for TS 38.181 Rel.17 SAN testing requirements.[52] | Signal bandwidth up to 160 MHz or 200 MHz, delay requirements, and residual Doppler requirements for LEO.[52] | SMW B10/B14 supports signal bandwidths up to 160 MHz, delay requirements, and residual Doppler requirements for LEO; SMW B9/B15 is recommended for testing needs up to 200 MHz with support for delay and residual Doppler requirements for LEO.[52] | R&S FSW / FSVA 5G NR options are described as supporting Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 measurements in the NTN source context.[50] |
| NTN component testing uses DUT, R&S SMW200A, and R&S FSW.[57] | Frequency coverage, RF modulation bandwidth, analysis bandwidth, and cellular / OFDM / vector signal generation or analysis software are the measurable capability areas listed for component testing.[57] | R&S SMW200A is summarized for component testing as frequency up to 67 GHz, overrange 72 GHz, RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz, up to 4 GHz with R&S SMW-K555, and signal generation software for LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18 via K171, OFDM via K114, and custom digital modulation.[57] | R&S FSW is summarized for component testing as frequency up to 85 GHz, overrange 90 GHz, analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz, and signal analysis software for LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18 via K171, OFDM via K96, and Vector signal analysis via K70.[57] |
| NTN changes wireless T&M assumptions because both UE and network entities can be mobile and test setups must include high path loss, Doppler shift, time delay, delay variance, atmospheric effects, Faraday effect, scintillation, and weather influences.[92] | High path loss, Doppler shift, time delay, delay variance, atmospheric effects, Faraday effect, scintillation, and weather influences.[92] | R&S SMW200A can be equipped with fading emulator support for TDL / CDL, custom fading profile, Doppler, delay, path loss, and R&S SMW-K820 customized dynamic fading; R&S SpaceNexus can configure satellite constellation, UE position / mobility, time-variant Doppler, time-variant propagation delay, path loss, and weather-induced attenuation and remote configure SMW200A.[30] | R&S FSW / FSWX supports satellite payload testing, EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, and phase-coherent multichannel measurement.[30] |

The 5G FWA UE test requirement taxonomy is a solution overview and does not provide test cases, limits, configurations, or pass / fail criteria.[15]

cited_passages.text:
NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。
